subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-party core rescueWatchdog cron/service-control recovery feature in this PR after a rebase, or defer this recovery work to the broader gateway recovery design?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a narrow code repair: the PR adds core recovery behavior, service-control command execution, and protocol surface that needs maintainer ownership and live proof.

options.title: Require rebase and proof first
options.body: Ask for a rebase onto current cron/protocol contracts plus redacted live managed-gateway repair proof before deciding final product acceptance.

options.title: Split out daemon hardening
options.body: Extract the launchd/service-control hardening into a smaller PR while leaving rescueWatchdog design on the canonical recovery issue.

options.title: Defer core watchdog work
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want a core rescue watchdog surface now.

recommendation.title: Require rebase and proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase onto current cron/protocol contracts plus redacted live managed-gateway repair proof before deciding final product acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most directly owns the current cron/protocol contract work that this PR must preserve and is a likely sponsor for the product-direction decision.
